'''Raeda-Ke''' was a [[Voss (species)|Voss]] [[Voss Mystics|Healer Mystic]] who was [[Death/Legends|slain]] by the [[Gormak/Legends|Gormak]] [[Chief/Legends|chieftain]] [[Althu]] during the [[Galactic War]]. A [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] was issued on Althu's head for the crime.
